metadata.description: Yelban's Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) writing & fable-learning skills for Claude Code — good-writing-tw (rewrite for Paul Graham / 余光中 / 王鼎鈞 style), humanizer-tw (remove AI writing traces, 台灣繁中), fable-econ (Amanda Askell's economics fable), fable-explore (cross-domain fable concept explorer).

plugins.name: writing-skills
plugins.description: 繁體中文（台灣）寫作與寓言學習技能合輯，一次安裝四支 skill：good-writing-tw（依 Paul Graham／余光中／王鼎鈞風格改寫）、humanizer-tw（去除 AI 寫作痕跡）、fable-econ（Amanda Askell 經濟學寓言）、fable-explore（跨領域寓言概念探索）。
